title: Employee Handbook
content:
Organization A Employee Handbook

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Teams may agree on different schedules with their manager.

Attendance: Employees should record attendance using the company attendance system. Missed entries should be reported to the manager and HR within two working days.

Workplace conduct: Employees must communicate respectfully, protect company information, and follow acceptable-use policies. Company devices must be used primarily for approved work. Loss or damage should be reported to IT support.

General employee questions should be submitted through the internal HR helpdesk.

title: Employee Leave Policy
content:
Organization A Employee Leave Policy — Version 1

Annual leave: Full-time employees receive 18 working days per calendar year. Leave is credited monthly.

Sick leave: Employees receive 8 working days per calendar year. For an absence longer than two consecutive working days, HR may request supporting documentation.

Request process: Submit planned leave through the employee portal and obtain manager approval before making non-refundable travel arrangements.

Carry-forward: Up to 5 unused annual-leave days may be carried into the next calendar year and must be used by March 31.

This policy applies to Organization A employees. Contact the HR helpdesk with questions.

title: Employee Expense Policy
content:
Organization A Employee Expense Policy

Employees may request reimbursement for approved business expenses. During approved business travel, meal expenses may be reimbursed up to INR 900 per person per day with itemized receipts and manager approval.

Local business travel should use an approved economical option. Claims must include the date, business purpose, and receipt where available.

Submit expense claims within 15 calendar days. Finance reviews complete claims within 7 working days. Personal purchases, penalties, and expenses without a valid business purpose are not reimbursable.

title: Deployment Guide
content:
Organization A Engineering Deployment Guide

Preparation: Confirm required automated tests have passed and the pull request is approved.

Release: Deploy to staging first. Run the smoke-test checklist and verify application health before requesting production approval. Only an authorized release engineer may initiate production deployment. Record the release version, time, and approving reviewer.

Rollback: If critical health checks fail, stop the rollout, follow the rollback procedure, notify the on-call engineer, and record the incident.

title: Employee Handbook
content:
Organization B Employee Handbook

Working hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:30 PM. Department managers may approve schedule adjustments where business needs allow.

Attendance: Record attendance in the organization portal. Report missed entries to the manager and HR within two working days.

Employees must communicate respectfully, protect confidential information, and follow approved information-security procedures. Lost organization-issued devices must be reported to IT support immediately.

General employee questions should be submitted through the Organization B HR helpdesk.

title: Employee Leave Policy
content:
Organization B Employee Leave Policy — Version 1

Annual leave: Full-time employees receive 20 working days per calendar year. Leave is credited monthly.

Sick leave: Employees receive 10 working days per calendar year. HR may request supporting documentation for extended absences under company policy.

Planned leave should be submitted through the employee portal and approved by the employee's manager. Up to 4 unused annual-leave days may be carried forward and must be used by February 28.

This policy applies only to Organization B employees.

title: Employee Expense Policy

Organization B Employee Expense Policy

Local business travel should use an approved economical option. Claims must include the date, business purpose, and receipt where available.

Submit expense claims within 20 calendar days. Finance reviews complete claims within 8 working days. Personal purchases, penalties, and expenses without a valid business purpose are not reimbursable.

title: Deployment Guide
content:
Organization B Engineering Deployment Guide

Preparation: Confirm automated tests have passed and the pull request has received the required review.

Release: Deploy to the test environment first. Complete smoke tests and verify application health before production approval. An authorized release engineer must initiate production deployment and record the release identifier, time, and reviewer.

Rollback: If a critical health check fails, stop the rollout, follow the rollback procedure, and notify the on-call engineer. Link each deployment to its approved change request for auditability.
